marta-sales: quick heads up — Strata (existing customer) hit 3x committed usage this quarter, CS asked for a renewal conversation. they want a 20% uplift discount + shortened notice period. can we rebaseline the ratecard or do we need deal desk approval?
ashton-se: ouch. do we have the current commit / term? last PO was annual, $120k commit, 8 GPU reserved (dedicated). usage spike looks like bursty embedding-heavy traffic. can you share telemetry? :eyes: 
marta-sales: sent telemetry excerpt to the thread — high embedding and rerank calls between 9-11pm PST. cs says it's organic growth, wants to keep dedicated at same slot but lower $/token.
ashton-se: lowering $/token impacts revenue. if they keep reserved capacity we can consider a volume-tier discount, not a straight 20%. propose: 10% base + 5% for 3rd-year commit; or restructure to a higher commit at 15% now.
deal-desk: need an economics summary + legal exceptions. for a 20% across-the-board discount we escalate to VP sales. include ARR delta and MRR impact. also include whether Dedicated resources are contiguous or can be burstable.
elaine-cs: customer is sensitive to SLA. they asked about shorter notice (30 days) to downscale. our standard is 90 days for dedicated. operations flagged that 30 days is operationally risky.
sam-legal: legal is ok with special terms for notice if finance gets signoff on expanded commit. need proposed contract language. also confirm data residency / security posture — they will email a security questionnaire.
ashton-se: technical constraints: (1) if they want same perf at lower $/token, we'll need to switch to smaller quantized model variants for non-critical routes, (2) prefix caching can recover cost — ask product for a caching plan.
marta-sales: action items: 1) ashton to draft pricing options with ARR impact, 2) deal-desk to run approval path for >15% discount, 3) sam to draft contract clause for 30-day notice conditional on increased commit, 4) elaine to confirm ops feasibility. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
ashton-se: putting numbers here for review: current ARR = $120k. option A: 10% uplift discount -> ARR becomes $108k (delta -12k). option B: 15% with 12-month higher commit -> ARR $102k but customer ups commit to $140k -> net +20k YOY. include unit economics (tokens/sec) in the doc.
deal-desk: noted. please include expected retention probability and churn risk in the justification. if retention prob > 85% we can approve up to 15% without exec signoff.
marta-sales: customer meeting scheduled Tue 11am PT. I'll present option A and B. if they push for 20% I'll ask for an immediate 18-month commit.
elasince: (ops-bot): deploy bot log — flagged dedicated pool fragmentation risk if we reduce notice below 60 days. Suggest guardrail: allow 30-day downscale only if customer migrates low-priority traffic to hosted tier during the window.
sam-legal: draft clause: "Customer may request accelerated downscale with 30 days' notice provided Customer increases committed spend by X% or migrates defined workloads to Hosted Redwood tiers; otherwise 90-day notice applies." send me the final numbers.
marta-sales: thanks everyone — i'll compile and drop a slide with ARR impact and legal clause before EOD. ping me if you need any numbers. :thumbsup:
